description: Defines an abstract class WebserviceEntityOperation for handling web service operations in vtiger CRM, including method stubs for unsupported operations and utility functions for field details and editability.

classes.name: WebserviceEntityOperation
classes.description: Abstract class providing a base for web service entity operations, with methods for CRUD operations (unsupported by default), field detail retrieval, and editability checks.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws exception indicating create operation is not supported.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Throws exception indicating retrieve operation is not supported.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Throws exception indicating update operation is not supported.

methods.name: revise
methods.description: Throws exception indicating revise operation is not supported.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws exception indicating delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Throws exception indicating query operation is not supported.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Throws exception indicating describe operation is not supported.

methods.name: getFieldTypeDetails
methods.description: Returns details about a web service field, such as reference list, picklist values, max upload size, or date format.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Determines if a web service field is editable based on display type, data type, read-only status, and UI type.

methods.name: getIdField
methods.description: Returns a standard ID field array with label and properties.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Abstract method to get EntityMeta instance.

methods.name: getMetaInstance
methods.description: Abstract method to get an instance of EntityMeta.
